EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

This Offer Letter is made on January 1, 2026, by TechCorp ("Employer") to Jane Doe ("Employee").

Section 1. POSITION AND DUTIES: The Employee is hired as a Senior Software Engineer. The Employer reserves the right to change the Employee's role, duties, and reporting structure at any time without prior notice.

Section 2. COMPENSATION: The Employee will receive a base salary of Rs. 1,500,000 per annum. A performance bonus of up to 10% may be awarded at the absolute discretion of the Employer.

Section 3. PROBATION: The Employee will be on probation for 6 months. During probation, the Employer may terminate this employment immediately without cause or notice.

Section 4. TERMINATION: After probation, either party may terminate employment by giving three (3) months' written notice. The Employer may terminate immediately with cause, including poor performance.

Section 5. NON-COMPETE: The Employee agrees that during employment and for a period of two (2) years after termination, they will not work for, consult with, or start any business that competes with the Employer in any country where the Employer operates.

Section 6. CONFIDENTIALITY: The Employee shall not disclose any proprietary information, trade secrets, or business plans during or at any time after their employment. This obligation survives termination indefinitely.

Section 7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY: All intellectual property, code, inventions, and ideas created by the Employee during the term of employment, whether during working hours or on personal time, shall be the exclusive property of the Employer.

Section 8. GOVERNING LAW: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Any disputes will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Bangalore.
